q: The connection between sofic entropy and free energy in statistical mechanics is that:
opts: The sofic entropy of a Gibbs measure equals the free energy of the corresponding interaction
Sofic entropy counts free energy configurations of the graph approximations
Sofic entropy and free energy are dual via the Legendre transform
exp: Sofic entropy of a Gibbs measure for a nearest-neighbor interaction on a Cayley graph can be computed via a variational principle counting the number of consistent configurations on the approximating graphs, mirroring the free energy computation.
